cells.contract: Define six bounded scalar types and their wire representations, preserving absent optional strings, empty strings, string lists and unsigned integers.
cells.next_action: Recheck byte-exact values, oversize payload refusal and all six entry types on encoding changes.
cells.expected_artifact: Scalar wire and public input conformance cases.
acceptance_criteria: Accepted wire values round-trip exactly and oversized string lists fail without truncation.

cells.contract: Charge an explicit unsigned budget and retain the remaining amount over host work and resumed execution.

evidence.anchor: pub fn charge(&mut self, cost: u64)

cells.next_action: Recheck exact and insufficient debits and session re-entry on any metering change.
cells.expected_artifact: Fuel accounting and no-refill Consumer regressions.
acceptance_criteria: A refused debit preserves the original counter and a terminal VM never grants fresh Fuel.

cells.contract: Start admitted HIR on a caller-owned Fuel budget, yield explicit pending requests, accept typed replies and resume only on a later poll.
cells.next_action: Exercise the two-Effect Consumer and verify each pending-to-ready boundary on lifecycle changes.
cells.expected_artifact: A public Consumer trace with two requests answered on the original session.
acceptance_criteria: Accepting a receipt does not dispatch or execute the tail until the next poll.

cells.contract: Opt in to a local owner that revokes leases on close, drop or unwind before cleanup of pending native data.
cells.next_action: Run drop-order and unwind cases on local lifecycle edits and check the unwrapped VM auto traits.
cells.expected_artifact: LocalVm owner-drop, cancellation and independent generic VM tests.
acceptance_criteria: Local cleanup sees a revoked lease and unwrapped generic VM configurations retain their existing Send behavior.

cells.contract: Dispatch one authorized pending request to its own registered callback under an explicit host step.

evidence.anchor: pub fn dispatch(&mut self, authorized: AuthorizedRequest)

cells.next_action: Drive each request boundary and inject a foreign authorized request when changing dispatch.
cells.expected_artifact: Independent explicit-dispatch and cross-session refusal cases.
acceptance_criteria: Each admitted dispatch reaches one callback and cross-session requests never reach a callback.

cells.contract: Correlate a reply to the pending owner and generation and check live authority, type and domain before moving its saved frame.
cells.next_action: Exercise identity and domain refusal before any change to reply admission.
cells.expected_artifact: Reply validation tests covering wrong identity, live policy and returned native buffers.
acceptance_criteria: An ordinary refusal returns the original receipt and cannot re-enter or replace another pending request.

cells.contract: Check current host authority at receipt admission; the public session also rechecks grants before dispatch and re-entry.
cells.next_action: Revoke grants separately before dispatch, acceptance and re-entry when editing policy checks.
cells.expected_artifact: Live-authority denial cases at the original Effect boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Revoking authority stops the next affected boundary and does not replay previously committed work.

cells.contract: Terminate an explicitly cancelled session, reject its late receipts and preserve external mutations the host already committed.
cells.next_action: Cancel before dispatch, while pending and after acceptance whenever session state changes.
cells.expected_artifact: Consumer cancellation cases with retained committed values and fenced late replies.
acceptance_criteria: Cancelled work never runs its tail and a late reply never rolls back a completed mutation.

cells.contract: Issue non-owning local execution leases and invalidate every lease from a closed or dropped owner.
cells.next_action: Keep live, closed, dropped and sibling lease cases in the local-scope regression suite.
acceptance_criteria: All stale leases remain closed and a sibling scope remains independently usable.

cells.contract: Restore an admitted pending continuation against current host identity, policy and original Fuel. Resume on acceptance and polling.
cells.next_action: Run saved capture and parallel-barrier recovery across every accepted-member mask on re-entry changes.
cells.expected_artifact: Pending continuation and partial parallel recovery tests across two host data models.
acceptance_criteria: Re-entry retains the original budget, ordered results and already accepted work without redispatch.

cells.contract: Stage host-decoded pending and completed records, validate bounded recovery state and require explicit host finalization before publishing a recovered checkpoint.
cells.next_action: Inject bad versions, duplicate rows and commit failures before changing checkpoint finalization.
cells.expected_artifact: Consumer recovery tests for two host-owned record schemes and atomic finalization failures.
acceptance_criteria: A rejected or failed finalization publishes no partial recovered snapshot.

cells.contract: Keep previously committed host mutations observable after a later Fuel, callback or result failure and stop further Effects.

evidence.anchor: pub fn dispatch(&mut self, authorized: AuthorizedRequest)

cells.next_action: Verify external application state and terminal Fuel after failure between two Effects.
cells.expected_artifact: Two-Effect Consumer failure cases with one retained mutation.
acceptance_criteria: Failure after the first commit cannot roll it back, rerun it, or dispatch the remaining Effect.

cells.contract: Target a production runtime that owns persistent sessions, crash settlement and replay decisions across process restarts. Existing primitives work with host-managed persistence.
blockers: A production persistence and replay contract is still open. Host-owned checkpoint tests exercise a narrower boundary.

evidence.anchor: Persistence format, atomic settlement and crash recovery
or a complete durable owning VM,

cells.next_action: Define storage ownership, settlement ordering and duplicate-delivery rules for one crash between dispatch and acknowledgement.
cells.expected_artifact: A reviewed crash-boundary contract and a restart fixture with an external effect counter.
acceptance_criteria: The fixture kills and restarts a real process on both sides of the selected commit boundary and verifies the specified observable outcome.

cells.contract: Target an instruction representation and interpreter that can preserve HIR results, Fuel boundaries and explicit Effects. The current native VM executes HIR.
blockers: There is no admitted bytecode format or interpreter. A parity corpus is required to compare a future implementation against HIR.

evidence.anchor: from a durable VM and bytecode execution.

cells.next_action: Specify a minimal instruction format and a differential corpus covering arithmetic, suspension, acceptance and exhausted Fuel before proposing an interpreter.
cells.expected_artifact: A proposed instruction contract and HIR-versus-bytecode parity fixture.
acceptance_criteria: The proposed corpus states the expected value, Effect sequence and Fuel cutoff for every reference program.
